domain-information: A Food Coordinator reviews daily donation offers and assigns them to available drivers.
A Food Coordinator matches donors with nearby distribution partners in the recovery network.
A Food Coordinator monitors active deliveries and resolves issues when routes are delayed.
A Food Coordinator collects food recovery data.
A Food Coordinator compiles weekly reports on collected and distributed food for tracking impact.
A Recovery Driver checks their list of assigned pickups before starting their route.
A Recovery Driver collects surplus food from donors like restaurants and grocery stores.
A Recovery Driver delivers donations to distribution partners like shelters and food pantries.
A Recovery Driver records delivery confirmations to maintain accurate tracking of food recovery data.
A Recovery Driver reports any vehicle or timing issues to the coordinator during their route.
A Donor registers their business in the recovery network to contribute surplus food.
A Donor lists available food items and preferred pickup times.
A Donor prepares a donation with food items so it is ready for pick up.
A Donor receives confirmation when the donation has been collected.
A Donor views a monthly report to measure their contribution to food recovery.
A Distribution Partner registers their institution in the recovery network to receive food donations.
A Distribution Partner makes a donation offer.
A Distribution Partner sets their daily capacity for receiving and storing food.
A Distribution Partner confirms each delivery and logs the received quantities to enable tracking food recovery data.
A Distribution Partner reports unmet needs or recurring shortages to the coordinator.
A Community Volunteer signs up to help with sorting and packing donations.
A Community Volunteer attends local events of the recovery network to promote food recovery initiatives.
A Community Volunteer logs completed hours for community service recognition.
A Government Health Inspector reviews data on recovered food to assess community impact.
A Government Health Inspector sends en evaluation notice to the food coordinator.

domain objects.name: Food Coordinator
domain objects.description: Organizes donations, deliveries, and communication between all participants.

domain objects.name: Donation Offer
domain objects.description: Represents a donor’s available food items ready for collection.

domain objects.name: Delivery
domain objects.description: Represents a completed or scheduled transport of donated food.

domain objects.name: Route
domain objects.description: Defines the planned path for a delivery or pickup.

domain objects.name: Food Donation
domain objects.description: Represents a collection of food items contributed by a donor.

domain objects.name: Food Item
domain objects.description: An individual edible product available for donation.

domain objects.name: Weekly Report
domain objects.description: Summarizes weekly collection and delivery activity across the network.

domain objects.name: Food Recovery Data
domain objects.description: Aggregated information about donated, collected, and distributed food.

domain objects.name: Recovery Driver
domain objects.description: Collects donations and delivers them to partner organizations.

domain objects.name: Pickup Assignment
domain objects.description: A task assigned to a driver specifying where and when to collect food.

domain objects.name: Delivery Confirmation
domain objects.description: Proof that a delivery has been successfully completed.

domain objects.name: Issue Report
domain objects.description: Describes any delivery or pickup problems reported by drivers.

domain objects.name: Recovery Network
domain objects.description: The collaborative system connecting donors, partners, and volunteers.

domain objects.name: Donor
domain objects.description: A restaurant, store, or business contributing surplus food.

domain objects.name: Available Food Items
domain objects.description: List of food items ready for donation.

domain objects.name: Pickup Times
domain objects.description: Time windows when a donor’s food is available for collection.

domain objects.name: Distribution Partner
domain objects.description: An organization receiving and distributing donated food to communities.

domain objects.name: Daily Capacity
domain objects.description: The maximum amount of food a partner can store or distribute each day.

domain objects.name: Monthly Report
domain objects.description: A donor’s summary of total contributions and impact per month.

domain objects.name: Delivery Log
domain objects.description: A record of completed deliveries including quantities and recipients.

domain objects.name: Shortage Report
domain objects.description: A partner’s report of unmet food needs or low supply.

domain objects.name: Community Volunteer
domain objects.description: Supports operations, events, and community outreach for the recovery network.

domain objects.name: Completed Hours
domain objects.description: Tracks the total hours a volunteer has contributed.

domain objects.name: Local Event
domain objects.description: Community activity promoting food recovery awareness.

domain objects.name: Government Food Inspector
domain objects.description: Reviews data and compliance related to food safety and distribution.

domain objects.name: Evaluation Notice
domain objects.description: A formal request or feedback document sent to assess network performance.

associations.description: Food Donation is delivered to Distribution Partner.
Donor creates Donation Offer for available food.
Donor provides Food Donation to the network.
Food Coordinator reviews and assigns Donation Offer for pickup.
Donor participates in the Recovery Network.
Distribution Partner operates within the Recovery Network.
Community Volunteer helps process and handle Food Donation.
Food Coordinator manages the operations of the Recovery Network.
Food Coordinator assigns Pickup Assignment to Recovery Driver.
Food Coordinator oversees each Delivery process.
Pickup Assignment is carried out by Recovery Driver.
Recovery Driver performs the Delivery.
Recovery Driver submits Issue Report when problems occur.
Issue Report is sent to Food Coordinator for resolution.
Distribution Partner receives Delivery from Recovery Driver.
Recovery Driver submits Delivery Confirmation after drop-off.
Distribution Partner validates the Delivery Confirmation.
Distribution Partner records completed deliveries in Delivery Log.
Delivery Confirmation contributes to Food Recovery Data.
Delivery Log adds information to Food Recovery Data.
Distribution Partner submits Shortage Report when supplies are insufficient.
Shortage Report informs Food Coordinator about demand gaps.
Donor receives Monthly Report summarizing contributions.
Food Recovery Data is used to generate Monthly Report.
Food Recovery Data is summarized into Weekly Report.
Food Coordinator reviews Weekly Report for planning.
Recovery Network hosts Local Event for awareness and community engagement.
Community Volunteer participates in Local Event activities.
Government Food Inspector reviews Food Recovery Data for compliance.
Government Food Inspector issues Evaluation Notice to Food Coordinator.
Evaluation Notice requests Food Coordinator to provide responses or improvements.
